title: Batch-landed research results drop logs/ (gitignored): a producer_failed run leaves no cause on main
note: [RESEARCH-OPS-20261012-2047] MEASURED: .gitignore:32 'logs/' ignores comms/research/RQ-20261009-903/38258786887/logs/cmd-0.log although run-manifest.json points at it; 105 older comms/research logs/ files ARE tracked. Cost: RQ-20261009-903 failed in 0.3 s and the cause had to be re-derived by running the script (it was the ICT_OFFVM_BUILD_HOST guard). Fix: have the collector land the last N lines of a failed command's log (force-add or fold into verdict note) for exit != 0 only. Clears when a producer_failed record on main carries its failing command's stderr tail.
